notes.en: Complete pinned source kit, including all original assets and individual credits. The exact 1,638-file ARM64 Linux package passed 42 checks in a native aarch64 Debian container: Node 20.19.2 automatic WebSocket compatibility and Node 22.23.4, real Chromium screenshots, software WebGL2, inspector controls and owned-process cancellation. This is Linux component qualification, not App installation or an App guest run. The iOS large-source consumer compiled and passed seven curated-consumer plus one resource-stager checks; Android is not offered. Existing task, network and workspace permissions remain authoritative. Runtime prerequisites must be present or prepared in the resolved Linux environment through existing tools; no host fallback or bundled native binary.
notes.zh-Hans: 完整保留固定上游源包、全部原有素材及各自署名。精确的 1,638 文件 ARM64 Linux 包在原生 aarch64 Debian 容器通过 42 项检查，覆盖 Node 20.19.2 自动 WebSocket 兼容、Node 22.23.4、真实 Chromium 截图、软件 WebGL2、检查器对照及自有进程取消。这是 Linux 组件验证，不代表 App 安装或 App 内 guest 执行。iOS 大包消费者已编译并通过七项目录消费者及一项资源暂存检查；本次不提供 Android 安装。继续遵守既有任务、网络及工作区权限。运行前置依赖须已存在或通过现有工具在解析后的 Linux 环境准备；不回退宿主机，不内置原生二进制。
